test_title: PYST 25: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 1 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fc097d16b0b57e7bfc1eb17a5b3fcd339317f03d490d82f675a56fc1db8524c.png]
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **1 ball are decreasing after each step and the balls moves in clockwise direction.

 The stick is moving in anticlockwise direction.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26bd2e93adaadabf116e1cade0a17defe81c1677be5c37da5a1ac62f068c67f4.png] 

The next step will be:

 **There will be 2 balls left.

 The stick will face point towards top left.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f74cab2a0d1330f3128b3c7f5b3339216cfa3b04e450ff1eb9cbf693e1955850.png] 

Now we consider the given options:

Option 1) The pattern matches completely.

Option 2) Position and number of balls is incorrect.

Option 3) Position of stick is wrong.

Option 4) Number of balls is wrong and position of stick is wrong.

Hence **the correct answer is option 1)**
